requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE MASTER CONCEPT ART SHEET for Võ Lâm Hero Defense, Phase 1G, arena enemies Waves13–16. CONCEPT ONLY, NOT animation frames, NOT a production spritesheet.
Reference inputs in order: approved concept masters Waves1–4, Waves5–8, Waves9–12; actual production four-facing idle previews for Waves1–4 and Waves9–12, which include the actual approved Cái Bang hero. Use these images directly as the visual standard. Keep the reference hero's design unchanged wherever shown. Original new creatures, not copied from commercial games.
Style: match the attached detailed chibi Chinese wuxia PIXEL ART precisely. Crisp square pixel clusters, thin near-black stepped outlines, limited material palettes with3–4 shade clusters, warm upper-left light, small soft contact shadows. Orthographic ELEVATED top-down three-quarter overworld camera, visible top planes on skulls, shoulders, feet and weapons. Cardinal left/right views remain elevated, NOT flat side-scroller profile. No isometric, no3D, no smooth vector or painterly gradients, no blur. Same visual pixel density/proportions as approved creep and hero references.
Composition: polished ivory parchment landscape reference sheet, preferably1536x1024 or larger same3:2 aspect. Match old master layout: FOUR generously spaced horizontal rows, one creature per row, with readable Vietnamese title and English subtitle at left. Across each row: FRONT (faces viewer/down), BACK (faces away/up), LEFT (faces screen-left), RIGHT (faces screen-right), one ACTION pose,6 palette swatches, a small weapon/anatomy detail callout and a relative SCALE comparison beside the existing red-robed staff Cái Bang. Every figure complete, uncut, ample margins and no overlap. The four turnarounds in a row are ONE identical design rotated, with same horn count, fur markings, clothes, weapons and anatomy. No animation sequences. All four directions required for every enemy. Keep action effects contained in the action pose, not separate VFX assets.
Header text: "ARENA CREEPS — CONCEPT 13–16". Small header: "PHASE 1G • CONCEPT ONLY • SCALE APPROXIMATE".
ROW13 title "13 Ma Khuyển", subtitle "Demon Hound": fast aggressive FOUR-LEGGED hound, supernatural relative of Wave1 Wild Dog. Preserve canine family pointy ears, muzzle, paws and bushy tail, but redesign anatomy into a lower, longer predator with larger angular jaw, prominent ivory fangs, muscular high shoulders, long hooked claws and coarse raised hackle ridge. Charcoal-black fur with deep crimson underside/hackles, glowing red eyes, THREE small burning orange patches along back and compact glowing paws. No oversized flame cloak, no pet/cute puppy, no horns/wings, no simple recolor. Back shows tail/hackles, not eyes on rear head. Signature action: forward leaping bite with tucked hind legs, reaching forepaws and small paw embers. Detail: fanged muzzle and clawed glowing paw. Scale trio: actual Cái Bang, approved Wave1 Wild Dog, new hound. Approx proposed hound height34 logical px versus dog27 and hero44; longer body about54px nose to rump, no exact production claim.
ROW14 title "14 Tiểu Hỏa Quỷ", subtitle "Fire Imp": small agile mischievous demonic humanoid, bright vermilion/orange skin shaded dark red, TWO small symmetrical curved charcoal horns, large glowing yellow eyes, sharp ivory claws, lean little limbs and bare clawed feet. Small dark-purple waist wrap with crimson tie; tiny charcoal-tipped tail. Flames ONLY around hands, compact yellow/orange shapes leave torso/face readable; no fire covering the whole body. Signature action: quick forward claw/fireball throw, one SMALL compact fireball by the outstretched palm. Detail: two-horn head and flame hand. Scale beside hero44px, imp approximately32px including horns, much smaller than cultist and brute.
ROW15 title "15 Hỏa Pháp Sư", subtitle "Fire Cultist": human ranged fire sorcerer, tall narrow triangular HOODED silhouette, face covered by dark mask with two orange glowing eyes. Full-length black/dark-purple robe with dark crimson split panels, long sleeves, bronze edging and a few SIMPLE burning-orange flame sigils, red sash; floating tiny embers only. Consistently carry ONE long slender dark wooden staff in ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand (viewer-left in front), top holds a faceted burning orange crystal in a blackened bronze lotus-shaped cradle. No prayer beads, no bald head, no bare muscular monk arms, no thick double-ended martial pole. Visibly distinct from attached Wave6 bald stocky Corrupted Monk. Signature action: raise the same crystal staff while charging a compact orange fireball above crystal. Detail: exact staff/crystal and robe sigil. Scale trio hero44, approved Wave6 Monk46, cultist48 body excluding staff. Staff taller than body; full tip visible.
ROW16 title "16 Ngưu Ma", subtitle "Horned Demon Brute": massive muscular bull-headed upright demon, strong bovine muzzle and nostrils, TWO enormous matched curved ivory/dark-tipped horns extending sideways then up, glowing red eyes, charcoal-maroon skin, broad shoulders and thick muscular arms, dark bronze/black Chinese lamellar shoulder/waist armor, crimson sash, heavy bracers, cloven hooves. No wings or fire halo. One HUGE consistent single-crescent Chinese battle axe with black iron crescent blade, bronze collar and long dark wooden haft; weapon anatomy and head shape same in all views, normally carried in anatomical right hand, both hands grip in overhead action. Signature pose: massive overhead axe smash anticipation, powerful forward lean; small dust/ember hint only, no separate ground shockwave art. Detail: axe and bull horns. Scale trio hero44, approved Stone Golem66, brute approximately66px INCLUDING horns, similar overall mass to golem but taller V-shaped muscular torso/hooves and wide horns distinct from rounded stone fists. Clearly regular enemy, not giant boss.
Shared palette family charcoal, dark purple, crimson, orange, glowing yellow, but distinct value hierarchy: hound darkest low quadruped; imp brightest small orange humanoid; cultist dark vertical robe; brute broad dark bronze/maroon with ivory horns. Do not make all red or surround them with oversized flames. Maintain gameplay-scale readability on green arena grass. Include visible palette swatches, actual hero relative comparisons and complete equipment silhouettes. Do NOT draw maps, HUD, bosses, other waves or animation atlases.

Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Phase1G master concept sheet ONLY to correct TURNAROUND CONSISTENCY. Keep the four established character designs, size, palette, art technique, layout, titles and labels. This is concept art, not an animation atlas.
The existing first image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Do not redesign the creatures.
Correct these specific directional errors:
1. Ma Khuyển row13: the figure under LEFT currently faces screen-right and the figure under RIGHT faces screen-left. Redraw/reposition the appropriate two side depictions so LEFT has muzzle to screen-left and RIGHT has muzzle to screen-right. Preserve the same dark crimson/black quadruped, red eyes, fangs, glowing paws and three small back flames.
2. Hỏa Pháp Sư row15: ensure LEFT faces screen-left and RIGHT faces screen-right, NOT reversed. Lock the staff to the character's anatomical RIGHT hand for ALL views: FRONT staff on viewer-left, BACK staff on viewer-right, and correct corresponding hand in each side view/action. Staff must remain the same long dark shaft, bronze lotus cradle and pointed faceted orange crystal in all depictions. Keep the flame-sigil black/crimson full robe, hooded masked face, orange eyes, sash. In action show the faceted crystal still present under charging glow, not a different rounded staff finial.
3. Ngưu Ma row16: existing two side views both face screen-left. LEFT must have bull muzzle to screen-left; RIGHT must have bull muzzle to screen-right, with the same two horns, armor, hooves, crimson sash and single-crescent axe. Keep axe in anatomical right hand; equipment should be visible from the appropriate side, never vanish/reinvent.
4. Tiểu Hỏa Quỷ row14 already has correct facing. Preserve it, but give the neutral views a tiny close-fitting orange/yellow flame around each hand so the hands visibly meet the design brief without obscuring claws.
Every character row must have exactly FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT and ACTION. FRONT faces down/viewer; BACK faces away; LEFT faces left; RIGHT faces right. Same elevated top-down camera on ALL views, not flat side-scroll. Keep drawings full and uncut with clear margins; unchanged ivory backdrop. No extra designs or frames.
